principles: Layer 2 proof can unlock only Layer 2 Engineering, never higher layers.
Formal proof must be rebuilt from final-report artifacts, not trusted from a handwritten suite summary.
All proof artifacts for this run must live under .lattice, with no new .omx baseline output.
Host-neutral review evidence must stay separate from Authority receipts.
drivers: User requested an exact path to unlock Layer 2, not another planning loop.
Existing evaluator already has strict fail-closed checks; only correctness blockers should change.
The repo workflow requires story-scoped PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST/DONE evidence.

options.name: A: minimal formal unlock execution under .lattice
pros: Fixes the real artifact-root and formal proof execution blockers
Reuses existing evaluator and tests instead of inventing a new framework
cons: Requires careful artifact generation and fail-closed traps
Does not solve Production Safety or global unattended claims

options.name: B: broaden into production Authority implementation
cons: Would violate non-authority CLI boundary in this story
Adds complexity before Engineering proof is unlocked

options.name: C: rely on existing B-ce79 proof bridge without fresh execution
cons: Does not produce fresh Layer 2 suite proof
Risks stale or local-only proof reuse
Would not satisfy the user request to execute until PASS

chosen: A: minimal formal unlock execution under .lattice
rationale: Choose the minimal formal unlock execution because the real blocker is fresh .lattice proof consumption and claim authorization, not a new Authority or Production layer.

preMortem.trigger: A command uses default artifactsRoot or stale help text
preMortem.consequence: The run violates the user policy and cannot unlock
preMortem.mitigation: Change formal baseline default/root documentation where needed and run explicit no-.omx checks after proof generation

preMortem.scenario: A forged or stale suite summary unlocks Layer 2
preMortem.trigger: The evaluator trusts baseline-suite-report.json instead of rebuilding from final-report artifacts
preMortem.mitigation: Keep rebuilt-vs-stored suite comparison and add adversarial traps for forged summary and stale materialHash

preMortem.scenario: Host verdicts are mistaken for Authority
preMortem.trigger: Review artifact wording or claim report sets receiptVerified/productionDone/fullAuthorityDone true
preMortem.mitigation: Assert final claim keeps higher layers locked and production/Authority fields false

preMortem.scenario: Expected-block security or migration baselines are converted into fake PASS
preMortem.trigger: Pressure to make all nine reports say PASS
preMortem.consequence: False DONE and unsafe capability claim
preMortem.mitigation: Allow only definition-supported outcomes and require gate/refusal evidence for EXPECTED_BLOCK or gated PASS
